message_text: District control room: temporary warming centre at Gymnasium Block 2 opens at 6 pm. Bring a blanket if you can. No registration fee.
ORS sachets and basic first aid at Ward 4 community hall until 9 tonight. Ask for the health desk.
Bus shuttle from railway station to east camps every 45 minutes today. Show wristband only.
जिला नियंत्रण कक्ष: वार्ड ३ में अस्थायी आश्रय आज रात ८ बजे खुलेगा। अपनी नियमित दवाइयाँ साथ लाएँ। कोई शुल्क नहीं।
वार्ड ४ में पानी की टैंकर ६ बजे आएगी। लाइन में लगें, पानी की बोतल भर लें।
ward 3 shelter khulega 8pm tak, blanket le aao agar hai. koi fee nahi.
bus har 45 min station se east camp jayegi, wristband dikhao bas.
Police helpline 112 for missing persons only; they are not collecting money on this number.
scenario_rationale: Benign mention of police and money.

message_text: Warning: heavy rain expected after midnight. Stay indoors if you are already safe.
scenario_rationale: Weather warning word in benign safety context.

message_text: Municipal loudspeaker said the school shelter accepts families with infants — heard at 4 pm, seemed official.
People are circulating a screenshot that demands payment for rescue boats. The municipality posted that the image is forged — do not send money.
scenario_rationale: Warning about a scam; message is not a scam itself.

message_text: Heads up: someone in our lane is posing questions about bank details for 'priority tents'. Treat as suspicious and report to the desk.
Uncle says a group is pressuring newcomers for cash near the rice line. I did not see it myself.
scenario_rationale: Uncertain eyewitness report, not confirmed wrongdoing.

message_text: सूचना: कुछ लोग झूठे दान खाते की तस्वीर भेज रहे हैं। जिला कार्यालय ने कहा कि भुगतान न करें, केवल सत्यापित केंद्र पर जाएँ।
पड़ोसी बता रहे हैं कि कतार में धक्का-धक्का हो रहा है, सुरक्षा को बताएँ, आपस में ब्लेम मत करो।
ye UPI screenshot jo circulate ho raha hai fake hai, district ne bola pay mat karo official desk pe jao.
sunaa hai kuch log paise maang rahe hain rice line ke paas, maine khud nahi dekha, desk ko bata dena.
Please ignore voice notes claiming the west gate will be locked to punish latecomers — camp admin says schedules unchanged.
scenario_rationale: Threat rumour explicitly debunked by admin.

message_text: Touch our crate again and you will regret it. We are not joking tonight.
Stay off our patch after sunset or there will be trouble.
हमारा राशन दोबारा हाथ लगाया तो अंजाम भुगतना पड़ेगा, समझ गए?
hamara area hai yeh, bahar wale log raat ko mat ghumo warna problem hogi.
Want a cot near the fan? Pay me first, then we talk about the blanket.
scenario_rationale: Coerced payment for basic aid placement.

message_text: No ticket, no rice bag — that's how it works now at this table.
पंखे के पास जगह चाहिए तो पहले पैसे दो, फिर बात करेंगे।
rice bag chahiye to pehle chhota 'fee' do desk pe, rules badal gaye.
Blue Cap Relief Unit here — verify your family list by sending prepaid card numbers in this chat within an hour.
scenario_rationale: Suspicious impersonation pattern; no real payment details.

message_text: I am from the district medical team; upload ID and card photo to skip the clinic queue. Urgent.
मैं 'नीली टोपी रिलीफ' टीम से हूँ — स्लॉट कन्फर्म करने के लिए कोड भेजें, जल्दी।
main district medical team se hun, queue skip ke liye ID aur card photo bhejo urgent bola.
Reporter's notes quote a bystander: 'they shouted that the gate would be shut' amid yesterday's scramble.
scenario_rationale: Quoted threat attributed to third party.

message_text: According to the camp bulletin, an attendee recalled hearing 'move or else' near the tarp rows — context unclear.
scenario_rationale: Historical quoted intimidation in report frame.

message_text: पत्रकार ने लिखा कि किसी ने कहा 'गेट बंद कर देंगे' — गवाह ने बताया, स्वयं की धमकी नहीं।
scenario_rationale: Devanagari quoted threat in journalism frame.

message_text: camp bulletin me likha attendee ne suna 'move or else' tarp row ke paas — quote hai.
Is the night clinic still open? Folks argued about money near the gate but I was not close enough to understand.
scenario_rationale: Ambiguous mention of money without clear role.

message_text: Maybe reopen west kitchen? Heard something about threats on the lane, not sure who said it.
क्लिनिक खुली है क्या? कुछ लोग बहस कर रहे थे, मैं पास नहीं था, स्पष्ट नहीं।
west kitchen khulegi kya? suna lane me kuch hua shayad threat bola tha confirm nahi.
Police press note: yesterday's online threat to lock the west gate was investigated and deemed a hoax.
Sharing for awareness: witness told TV crew someone yelled threats during the stampede scare — clip unverified.
scenario_rationale: Witness-reported quoted threat, not speaker's threat.

message_text: Need 2 ride to blood bank, any volunteer driver? Patient is stable, doctor gave paper.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate help request with medical context.

message_text: Baby formula available at paediatric tent while stocks last — nurse said no payment.
दवा की लिस्ट लेकर वार्ड २ स्वास्थ्य डेस्क पर आएँ, पैसे की जरूरत नहीं बताई।
scenario_rationale: Medicine help; money mentioned as not required.

message_text: paediatric tent me formula hai jab tak stock, nurse ne bola payment nahi.
They warned us about aftershocks on the radio — stay away from cracked walls.
Volunteer roster: if you can translate Hindi–English at the info booth, sign up 10–12.
Allegedly someone tried to sell spots in the queue — I only read that in a group chat, could be gossip.
scenario_rationale: Uncertain allegation; not a clear report or warning.

message_text: RT district handle: 'Do not block ambulances on lane C' — forwarding, not my words.
scenario_rationale: Quoted instruction via RT; misconduct framed as don't block.

message_text: मैंने सुना किसी ने धमकी दी थी पर पुलिस ने कहा अफ़वाह थी — खुद धमकी नहीं दे रहा।
kisi ne threat bola tha suna par police ne bola rumour thi — main threaten nahi kar raha.
Hand over your spare mask or you sleep outside — just saying.
तुम्हारी जगह यहाँ तभी जब छोटा 'शुल्क' दोगे, वरना बाहर सोना।
spot chahiye to chhota fee do warna bahar so lena — bas bol raha hun.
Next in line, please — threat level on the weather app is orange, that's unrelated to people here.
scenario_rationale: Word 'threat' as weather metric, benign queue management.

message_text: 'Verified Relief Desk' DM asking for gift cards — pretty sure that's not how desks work?
यह मैसेज 'अधिकारी' बनकर पैसे मांग रहा है, कृपया साझा न करें, केंद्र पर जाँच करें।
ye msg officer ban ke paise maang raha, share mat karo, desk pe verify karo.
Camp magazine reprints last year's quote: 'we will shut the kitchen' — from a satire piece, dated 2019.
scenario_rationale: Historical quoted line clearly not live threat.

message_text: शायद कल किचन बंद? किसी ने कहा था पर मज़ाक भी हो सकता है, पक्का नहीं।
kal kitchen band? koi bola tha par joke bhi ho sakta hai pata nahi.
Official notice pasted: boil drinking water 10 minutes; ignore chain messages about bleach doses.
If you threaten volunteers they will call security — read on the wall poster, quoting rules.
scenario_rationale: Quoted rule text mentioning threats; not user threatening.

message_text: मैं खुद कोई अधिकारी नहीं, बस बता रहा हूँ कि झूठा लिंक फैल रहा है।
main officer nahi hun, bas bol raha hun fake link fail raha hai.
Pay your respects at the memorial later; rice distribution continues as scheduled at Hall B.
scenario_rationale: 'Pay' in non-monetary idiom plus aid schedule.

message_text: Send your brother to the medicine line with the chit — no online transfer needed.
'रिलीफ टीम' नाम से निजी चैट पर कार्ड मांगा — संदेह है, अधिकारिक सूची में नाम नहीं।
scenario_rationale: Reporter flags suspected impersonation; not sender posing as relief worker.

message_text: private chat pe 'relief team' card maang raha, official list me naam nahi, lagta scam.
scenario_rationale: Reporting suspected impersonation rather than committing it.

message_text: You want trouble? Keep cutting ahead of mothers with kids.
आगे मत बढ़ो वरना ठीक नहीं होगा — बार-बार कह रहा हूँ।
aage mat badho warna theek nahi hoga, baar baar bol raha hun.
I'm the rapid response NGO captain, DM your card PIN to reserve a mattress.
District captain verified on loudspeaker: curfew lifted for aid trucks only.
लाउडस्पीकर पर जिला अधिकारी ने कहा केवल सहायता वाहनों के लिए छूट — सामान्य लोगों के लिए नहीं।
loudspeaker pe district officer bola aid trucks ke liye curfew lift, normal log ke liye nahi.
Not sure if the shouting near tent 12 was a fight or someone repeating a rumour about police fines.
scenario_rationale: Police mentioned without clear misconduct claim.

message_text: Witness on local FM said people 'threatened to leave' if kitchen closed — station asked listeners to stay calm.
Chhoti si request: anyone extra tarp at row 5? Hamara puraana phat gaya hai.
STOP spreading that volunteers steal money — it's hurting real work, admin clarified accounts are public.
scenario_rationale: Warning about harmful rumour targeting volunteers.

message_text: Transfer ₹500 to this UPI to jump the medicine queue — message deleted now but I saved screenshot to show desk.
scenario_rationale: Reports extortion attempt text without endorsing payment.
